content:
nicole: Hitting CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED on Windows CI when the Python async SDK talks to Dedicated via our proxy. Same CA file works on linux/mac. Anyone seen env-var vs cached client issues?

raj: Paste the error and your repro snippet pls.

nicole: Traceback shows httpx.ConnectError -> SSLCertVerificationError. Minimal repro (sdk 0.9.3):
```
os.environ['REDWOOD_BASE_URL']='https://dedicated.prod'
os.environ['REDWOOD_CA_BUNDLE']=r'C:\agent\temp\dedicated-ca.pem'
client = AsyncClient(token='x', base_url=os.environ['REDWOOD_BASE_URL'])
await client.chat.completions.create(...)
```
Works locally and on linux CI. Fails on Windows.

tim_ops: Two likely causes: (1) path handling on Windows (backslashes / Path.resolve()/as_posix issues) when we pass env CA into httpx; (2) AsyncClient instances are cached and if REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE was present earlier in the job the cached client may retain the old trust bundle.

katya: Also check which env we prioritize: REDWOOD_CA_BUNDLE should override REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE/SSL_CERT_FILE but code may defer to requests/httpx behavior.

nicole: Interesting — our pipeline sets REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE global at job start, then downloads the Dedicated CA later and sets REDWOOD_CA_BUNDLE. That ordering explains the mismatch.

raj: Temporary workaround: pass ca + trust_env to the constructor and set trust_env=False. e.g. AsyncClient(..., trust_env=False, ca=r'C:\agent\temp\dedicated-ca.pem'). Does the SDK forward those?

nicole: Yes, that fixed the Windows job. But mypy complains because the typed stub for AsyncClient doesn't include those kwargs.

tim_ops: Action items: normalize CA path inputs (Path(...).expanduser().resolve().as_posix()), make client cache key include normalized CA + trust_env + base_url (or stop caching AsyncClient), and document env var precedence with a warning log when both REDWOOD_CA_BUNDLE and REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE are set. Also add Windows CI reproducer (set REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE then overwrite REDWOOD_CA_BUNDLE in the same job).

katya: And update type stubs: AsyncClient __init__ should accept ca: Optional[Union[str, bytes, os.PathLike]] = None and trust_env: bool = True.

ci-bot: Reproducer job redwood-sdk-windows-ssl (build/4421) reproduced the failure.

raj: I'll open a small PR for path normalization + cache key + stub change and add the CI test. Will reference ticket #4789. Nicole, can you validate once merged?

nicole: Yep. Thanks, team. :thumbsup:
